settings.heading: Shipping charges
settings.body: We offer free shipping on all orders within India, with no minimum spend.

settings.heading: Dispatch & delivery
settings.body:
• Orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days.
  • Delivery typically takes 4–7 business days; metro cities are often faster.
  • You’ll receive a tracking link by SMS and email once shipped.

settings.heading: Cash on Delivery
settings.body: Cash on Delivery (COD) is available on eligible orders and serviceable pincodes. COD availability is confirmed at checkout.

settings.heading: Order tracking
settings.body: Track your order via the link sent to you after dispatch. For help with a specific order, reach us through our contact page or the chat on this site.

settings.heading: International shipping
settings.body: We currently ship within India only. International shipping is coming soon — join our newsletter to be the first to know.

settings.heading: Delays & accuracy
settings.body: Estimated timelines may vary due to courier delays, weather, or peak periods. Please ensure your shipping address and phone number are accurate to avoid delivery issues.

settings.heading: Shipping Policy
settings.intro: Everything you need to know about how and when your order arrives.
